## About
Hardy's Painting & Remodeling is a locally-owned, family business based on Trophy Club Drive. We paint interiors and exteriors for homes and businesses, and we also refinish cabinets, install countertops and lay flooring.
Magally Sacramento, Hardy's oldest daughter, is an owner and handles sales and marketing. Val Sacramento is also an owner and runs the day-to-day work in the field. Referrals and word of mouth bring us more new customers than anything else.
We work across the DFW Metroplex, mainly in Trophy Club, Westlake, Southlake, Keller, Grapevine and Flower Mound. Our neighbors have given us a 5 star rating across 34 Google reviews.

## Services
- Interior painting: Walls, rooms and common areas painted with care so the space feels finished and comfortable.
- Exterior painting: Fresh exterior paint for homes and businesses that makes a good first impression.
- Exterior staining: Thorough staining work for the outside of your home.
- Cabinet painting and staining: Refresh your kitchen or bath cabinets with new paint or stain.
- Countertop installation: We help you pick and install countertops for your kitchen or bathroom.
- Flooring and epoxy floors: Flooring inside the home, plus epoxy floors for the garage.
- Commercial painting: Painting projects for businesses and commercial spaces.
- Wrought iron fence painting: Painting for wrought iron fences.

## FAQ
Q: What areas do you serve?
A: Our main areas are Trophy Club, Westlake, Southlake, Keller, Grapevine and Flower Mound. If you're elsewhere in the Metroplex, give us a call.

Q: Do you only do painting?
A: Painting is our specialty, but we also install flooring, countertops, cabinets and more.

Q: Do you paint cars?
A: No. We are residential and commercial painters, so car painting isn't something we can take on.

Q: How do I get a quote?
A: Call us or fill out the online form and we'll get you a free quote.
